faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad Crop Protector (Kamdar) recruitment is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post in the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad recruitment.

faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation from a recognized institution and completed a 5-day training from the Agriculture and Horticulture Directorate. Knowledge of the local language and ability to climb trees and ride a bicycle are also essential.

faq.answer: The age limit for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post is between 18 years and 40 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Crop Protector (Kamdar) post will receive a salary of Rs. 11851 per month.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by the Junior Plant Protection Office Dhanbad.

faq.answer: The selection process involves the preparation of a merit list based on educational qualifications, knowledge of the local language, and a character certificate verified by a competent authority.
